from collections import Counter

def rare_colors(g):
    cnt = Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    dom = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return {c for c in cnt if c not in (dom, 0)}

def tile_axis(g, axis):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    n = h if axis == 0 else w
    line = lambda k: g[k] if axis == 0 else [g[i][k] for i in range(h)]
    seps = [k for k in range(n) if all(v == 0 for v in line(k))]
    rc = rare_colors(g)
    if seps:
        p = (seps[1] - seps[0]) if len(seps) >= 2 else (seps[0] + 1 if seps[0] + 1 <= n else n)
        if any(s % p != seps[0] % p for s in seps):
            return g
        wins = [list(range(k, min(k + p, n))) for k in range(0, n, p)]
        rarecount = lambda win: sum(1 for k in win for v in line(k) if v in rc)
        ref = max(wins, key=rarecount)
        refstart = ref[0]
        out = [row[:] for row in g]
        for win in wins:
            if win == ref: continue
            for pos, k in enumerate(win):
                if k in seps: continue
                src = refstart + pos % p
                if src >= n: continue
                if axis == 0: out[k] = list(g[src])
                else:
                    for i in range(h): out[i][k] = g[i][src]
        return out
    ds = {b - a for a in range(n) for b in range(a + 1, n)
          if line(a) == line(b) and any(v in rc for v in line(a))}
    if not ds: return g
    d = max(ds)
    if d < 3 or d >= n: return g
    wins = [list(range(k, min(k + d, n))) for k in range(0, n, d)]
    rarecount = lambda win: sum(1 for k in win for v in line(k) if v in rc)
    ref = max(wins, key=rarecount)
    refstart = ref[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for win in wins:
        if win == ref: continue
        for pos, k in enumerate(win):
            src = refstart + pos % d
            if src >= n: continue
            if axis == 0: out[k] = list(g[src])
            else:
                for i in range(h): out[i][k] = g[i][src]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    g = [list(r) for r in grid]
    g = tile_axis(g, 0)
    g = tile_axis(g, 1)
    return g
